params.message:
The writing partner writes a post in its sections

A new post opens in the Studio laid out in Signal, Why It Matters, Examples and
How To Activate It with Monday: and This quarter: under it, but the writing
partner still described a post as short paragraphs with a section or two, so
a first draft came in its own headings and had to be re-sectioned by hand.

The prompt now names the sections in order, spelled as the Studio lays them
out, says a heading is a line of its own, and that text for a section the
piece does not have yet starts with its heading. Articles and decks are
unchanged.
